description: This file defines the 'Token' class within the Twig templating engine, representing individual tokens during parsing of templates, including token types, properties, and utility methods.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Class representing a token in Twig's lexer, encapsulating token type, value, and line number with methods for testing and conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing token type, value, and line number.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the token.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Tests if the current token matches a specific type and/or value.

methods.name: getLine
methods.description: Returns the line number where the token was found.

methods.name: typeToString
methods.description: Converts token type enum to a string, optionally shortened.

methods.name: typeToEnglish
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the token type.
